rules.prepare:
# Debian's patches change configure.ac and some Makefile.am. One of them # (avoid-beta-warning) keeps autogen.sh from calling the version # "2.4.9-unknown" and a beta outside of upstream's git repository. (cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" && autoreconf -fi)
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --libexecdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gnupg" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --with-libgpg-error-prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --with-libgcrypt-prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --with-libassuan-prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --with-libksba-prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --with-npth-prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --with-pinentry-pgm="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/pinentry-curses" \ --with-agent-s2k-calibration=300 \ --with-mailprog=/usr/sbin/sendmail \ --enable-wks-tools \ --enable-large-secmem \ --disable-doc \ --disable-nls \ --disable-rpath
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
# Only the tests use it. rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/gpgscm"
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gnupg2" ln -sf ../gnupg/gpg-preset-passphrase \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gnupg2/gpg-preset-passphrase" ln -sf ../gnupg/gpg-protect-tool \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gnupg2/gpg-protect-tool"
ln -sf "gpg" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/gpg2"
